what_it_is: A MiSTer Saturn core save with the Backup RAM Cart appended: 1114112 bytes = 64 KiB internal + 1 MiB cart (512 KiB volume), both byte-expanded with 0xFF. PR #340 'Substituted in real mister internal + cart save': 'We were provided with a file containing internal + cart saves from a real MiSTer'. The cart volume was formatted by the BIOS, so its signature fills only 0x40 bytes of the 512-byte first block.
note: one-saves (saturn-backup) reads the cart volume's block size from the signature's repeat count and so rejects this file ('the save in block 528 states 1190 bytes and its blocks hold 144'); the converter switched to sizing blocks by file length because of this file.
